description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Essence Flux without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Corridor Monitor.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Genesis Chamber.
Resolve the Corridor Monitor, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
